description: Compact two-stage audio amplifier. NE5532 provides the low-level preamplifier stage and LM386 provides the final low-voltage audio power amplification stage. The design uses a shared single-supply style power rail, with NE5532 channel 1 feeding LM386 input through an AC-coupled or resistively coupled signal path, and LM386 driving the final audio output.

verification_assertions.desc: Ground/reference unification: NE5532 negative supply and LM386 ground must share one common ground net in single-supply operation.
Positive supply unification: NE5532 positive supply and LM386 supply must share one common power rail.
Critical net isolation: positive supply, ground, NE5532 stage-1 output, LM386 signal input, and LM386 power output must all reside on mutually distinct nets.
Unified ground/reference net must carry Ground electrical attribute.
Shared amplifier supply rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
LM386 inverting input must be ground-referenced for the intended single-ended input configuration.
Signal-chain continuity: NE5532 channel-1 output must reach LM386 non-inverting input through a legal passive coupling path.
The shared amplifier supply rail must have a bypass/decoupling capacitor to ground.
LM386 BYPASS pin should have a capacitor to ground for reference stabilization and improved PSRR.
LM386 power output pin must not be left floating; it should connect to an output network.
